j4q.input

Class J4QController

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.input.InputDevice
      • j4q.input.J4QController
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    J4QLeftController, J4QRightController

    public class J4QController
extends InputDevice
    Represents a VR controller, providing object picking, input state, and pose information.

    The J4QController class manages picking, joystick, trigger, squeeze, aim, and grip states.
